name: correctness-sweep
brief: Clear the 8 Correctness items and 3 Ungrouped prose items in .sir/backlog.md. Runtime fixes: Helm's backup ordinal becomes process-wide so two Helm services on one file cannot clobber a backup inside one millisecond (D1); HelmPanel's one-surface rule holds by compareError's own definition rather than reachability (D2); podBlockerFor names the exact (encoding) match over a decoded guess (D3); non-projects Beachcomber entries get a new 'absolute-path' pathSource so the 'path is a guess' caveat stops rendering for them (D4); the renderer's uncalled setPermissionMode action is removed (D7). Guards: _UncoveredAtSchemaHead is respelled through _AssertNever against migration 3 so it actually breaks the build (D5); MIGRATION_1 pins its lane-kind and event-type lists (D6). Comment-only: cite WAI-ARIA for aria-current='false' (D8) and fix three docblocks (P1-P3). Seven tasks; the tail runs repo-wide typecheck and the full suite.
